answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, because each one must be independent on the ledge graph and each exposes its bond to the orchard slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the nebula audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 4 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 6 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
